title: AgentOdyssey: Open-Ended Long-Horizon Text Game Generation for Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.24893v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: For agents to learn continuously from interaction with the world at test time, they must be able to explore effectively, acquire new world knowledge and skills, retain relevant episodic experiences, and plan over long horizons. To evaluate these key abilities of test-time continual learning agents, we introduce AgentOdyssey, a novel evaluation framework that procedurally generates open-ended text games with rich entities, world dynamics, and long-horizon tasks. Critically, AgentOdyssey goes beyond the conventional machine learning assumption that learning does not occur at test time by placing agents in a continuous, long-horizon setting that interleaves learning and inference throughout deployment. We further propose a multifaceted evaluation methodology that measures not only game progress but also offers diagnostic tests on world knowledge acquisition, episodic memory, object and action exploration, action diversity, and model cos

translated_title: AgentOdyssey：面向测试时持续学习智能体的开放式长程文本游戏生成
translated_abstract: 为了让智能体能够在测试时通过与世界的交互进行持续学习，它们必须能够有效地探索、获取新的世界知识和技能、保留相关的情景经验，并进行长程规划。为了评估测试时持续学习智能体的这些关键能力，我们提出了AgentOdyssey，这是一个新颖的评估框架，能够程序化地生成包含丰富实体、世界动态和长程任务的开放式文本游戏。至关重要的是，AgentOdyssey突破了传统机器学习中“测试时不发生学习”的假设，将智能体置于一个持续的、长程的环境中，在整个部署过程中交替进行学习与推理。我们进一步提出了一种多层面的评估方法，不仅衡量游戏进度，还提供关于世界知识获取、情景记忆、对象与动作探索、动作多样性以及模型一致性等方面的诊断测试。
tldr: AgentOdyssey是一个可程序化生成开放式长程文本游戏的评估框架，通过在部署全程中交替学习与推理的设定，从游戏进度、知识获取、情景记忆和探索能力等多维度评估测试时持续学习智能体的关键能力。
en_tdlr: AgentOdyssey is an evaluation framework that procedurally generates open-ended long-horizon text games, interleaving learning and inference throughout deployment to assess test-time continual learning agents on game progress, knowledge acquisition, episodic memory, and exploration abilities.
